{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
A '''centauriform''' or '''centaur''' was a type of [[Species/Legends|species]] that had the head and torso of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and the body of an [[Equine/Legends|equine]] animal. The [[Chironian]] species was one such centauriform.<ref name="WWNJO">{{InsiderCite|57|Who's Who in the New Jedi Order}}</ref>
